stories.story_fr: La focalisation accrue des entreprises sur la gestion des risques fait de Corporate Assurance la division a la croissance la plus rapide d'Intertek, avec une LFL de 6,8% sur l'exercice 2025.
stories.story_en: Companies' heightened focus on risk management makes Corporate Assurance Intertek's fastest-growing division, with FY2025 LFL growth of 6.8%.
stories.signal: Corporate Assurance, division la plus dynamique
stories.quote: The higher focus by companies on risk management is making Corporate Assurance our fastest growing division

stories.story_fr: La solution Assurance represente 22% du CA groupe FY25 et a ete la solution a la plus forte croissance entre 2015 et 2025, avec un CAGR de 13%.
stories.story_en: The Assurance solution represented 22% of FY25 group revenue and has been the fastest-growing solution between 2015 and 2025 with a 13% revenue CAGR.
stories.quote: Assurance represented 22% of our FY25 Group revenue and has been the fastest growing solution between 2015 and 2025 with a revenue CAGR of 13%

stories.story_fr: Intertek affiche un ROIC excellent de 21,3% sur l'exercice 2025 et une conversion de cash de 110%, generant un flux de tresorerie d'exploitation ajuste de 762 M£.
stories.story_en: Intertek posted an excellent FY2025 ROIC of 21.3% and 110% cash conversion, delivering adjusted operating cash flow of GBP 762m.
stories.quote: Continued strong cash performance: 110% cash conversion delivers adjusted operating cash flow of GBP762m ... Excellent ROIC of 21.3%

stories.story_fr: Sur la periode 2023-2025, l'execution de la strategie AAA a depasse les objectifs avec une croissance moyenne du CA de 6%, +240bps d'accretion de marge et +12,1% de croissance moyenne du BPA.
stories.story_en: Over 2023-2025, AAA strategy execution beat targets with 6% average revenue growth, +240bps margin accretion and +12.1% average EPS growth.
stories.quote: delivered at constant currency annual revenue growth of 6%, 240bps margin accretion and grown EPS 12% on average per annum

stories.story_fr: Au S1 2025, Intertek a enregistre son neuvieme semestre consecutif de croissance organique a un chiffre moyen et un ROIC excellent de 22,5%, en hausse de 170bps sur un an.
stories.story_en: In H1 2025, Intertek marked its ninth consecutive half-year of mid-single-digit organic growth and an excellent ROIC of 22.5%, up 170bps year-on-year.
stories.quote: H1 25 marks the ninth consecutive six-month period of consistent mid-single digit LFL revenue growth ... ROIC was excellent at 22.5%, up year-on-year by 170bps

stories.story_fr: Au S1 2025, la solide conversion de cash de 118% a permis de generer un flux de tresorerie d'exploitation ajuste de 266 M£, soutenant une hausse de 6,3% du dividende interimaire.
stories.story_en: In H1 2025, strong 118% cash conversion delivered adjusted operating cash flow of GBP 266m, supporting a 6.3% interim dividend increase.
stories.signal: Conversion de cash de 118% au S1
stories.quote: our strong cash conversion of 118% enabled us to deliver adjusted operating cash flow of GBP266m
